item.title: Elixir Energy Delivers Outstanding Results at Lorelle-3, Unveiling Significant Gas-Condensate Reservoirs
item.description: Elixir Energy (ASX: EXR) reports Lorelle-3: four gas-condensate reservoirs, northward Dunk extension; boosting Taroom Trough maiden reserves; 2026 flow tests.

item.title: Little Green Pharma to Divest WA Production Site in $7.8 Million Sale and Lease-Back Deal
item.description: LGP to sell WA production site for $7.8m in a sale-and-lease-back to fund Australian and European expansion; settlement targeted mid-March 2026.

item.title: Osmond Resources Reports High-Grade Assays from Zone 3 Drilling at Orión EU Critical Minerals Project
item.description: Osmond Resources (ASX: OSM) reports high-grade Zone 3 assays at Orión EU, expanding potential for titanium, zircon and TREO; fast-tracking development.

item.title: Magnum Mining Confirms Ionic Adsorption Clay Discovery at Azimuth Project
item.description: Magnum Mining (ASX: MGU) confirms ionic adsorption clay discovery at Azimuth, boosting Brazilian REE assets; also completes US Wet Mountain REE acquisition.

item.title: Peet Delivers Stellar H1 Earnings and Upgrades FY26 Outlook; Landbank Activation Key
item.description: Peet Ltd: H1 FY26 net operating profit up 102% to $50.9m; lifts FY26 NPAT guidance to $86-90m as landbank activation hits 76%.

item.title: Mitchell Services Flags Strong 1H26 Profit, Advances Loop Decarbonisation
item.description: Mitchell Services 1H26: NPAT $8.1m, EBITDA $21.4m (up 69%), net cash $7.2m; Sumitomo to acquire up to 25% of Loop Decarbonisation; 4c dividend.

item.title: Peninsula Energy on Track to Meet Forecast Production Guidance from Lance Uranium Project Restart
item.description: Peninsula Energy (ASX: PEN) on track to meet 0.5 million pounds uranium forecast from Lance restart as MU-4 ramp-up and CPP commissioning advances.

item.title: Alcidion Registers Miya Precision’s Concept Detection Capability in Australia and UK
item.description: Alcidion wins dual Class I SaMD registrations for Miya Precision in Australia and UK, enabling regulated, AI-assisted clinical documentation.

item.title: Zenith Minerals Expands Consolidated Dulcie Gold Project with New Mining Lease
item.description: Zenith Minerals expands the Dulcie gold system with a $1.45m purchase of adjacent M77/599 lease, 2% NSR, boosting the 675koz maiden resource and upside.

item.title: Tungsten Mining Raises $53m to Accelerate Feasibility Studies at Mt Mulgine Project
item.description: Tungsten Mining raises $53m to fast-track Mt Mulgine feasibility studies; oversubscribed placement signals strong investor confidence and near-term FID. ASX: TGN
